Parameters._comment: front-door requires a registered domain and ONE issued ACM certificate in us-east-1, which serves both CloudFront and the ALB. ssm-only has no public endpoint and no ALB, CloudFront, WAF or Cognito cost.
e.g. crew.example.com. Required only for front-door.
e.g. Z0123456789ABCDEFGHIJ. Required only for front-door.

ONE issued ACM cert in us-east-1 covering DomainName. Serves both the CloudFront viewer connection and the ALB HTTPS listener, because the template is pinned to us-east-1. A wildcard cert works. Bring your own.
existing reuses a VPC and its NAT, which is usually free because you already pay for them. create builds a dedicated VPC.
Exactly two PRIVATE subnets in distinct AZs, each with a default route to a NAT or transit gateway. deploy.sh verifies this before creating anything.
Only used when NetworkMode=create. nat-instance is roughly a tenth the cost of nat-gateway and becomes infrastructure you operate.

Graviton4, 2 vCPU / 16 GiB, ~$86/mo. Best price-performance shape meeting Crew's documented RAM floor. Subagent concurrency scales with MEMORY, so r8g.xlarge (32 GiB) is the lever for wider fan-out, not more cores.
Multi-arch index digest of ghcr.io/kirodotdev/kirocrew:stable resolved 2026-08-14. Re-resolve and re-verify with scripts/verify-image.sh before deploying; do not assume this digest is current.
Alarm destination. Email on purpose: alarm delivery must not depend on the Gateway being healthy.
Lowercase, digits and hyphens. Distinguishes multiple Gateways in one account; every globally unique name derives from the stack name plus this.
ON requires TOTP. Only weaken this deliberately.
